document.cue: Describe a traditional festival or celebration in your country.

text: I'd like to talk about Nauryz, which is probably the most important traditional celebration in Kazakhstan. It marks the spring equinox, so it takes place on the twenty-second of March, and in recent years the festivities have lasted for several days.

What I love about Nauryz is how many customs are involved. Families clean their houses beforehand, because it's believed you should start the new year with a fresh home and a clear conscience. Then people gather around a table to share nauryz kozhe, a special soup made of seven ingredients that symbolise happiness, luck and good health. In the cities, there are big open-air festivals, with yurts set up in parks, where you can watch traditional games, such as kokpar, listen to dombra music and try dishes from different regions. Elders give their blessings, and neighbours visit each other, even if they haven't spoken for months.

In my view, Nauryz matters so much because it's a living link to our nomadic past. It reminds us that our ancestors depended on nature, and that renewal was a cause for celebration rather than just another date on the calendar. It also brings people together regardless of age or background, which is rare in our fast-paced society. Personally, my favourite moment is the evening when the whole family sits together, and honestly, that feeling of warmth and belonging is what I'd miss most if the tradition ever disappeared.

tips.en: It's believed describes traditions without naming who believes them.
tips.kk: It's believed дәстүрлерді нақты адамсыз сипаттауға көмектеседі.
tips.ru: It's believed помогает описывать традиции без прямого указания лица.
tips.example: it's believed you should start the new year with a fresh home and a clear conscience

tips.en: Words such as symbolise, blessings and nomadic past convey cultural context precisely.
tips.kk: Symbolise, blessings, nomadic past сөздері мәдени мәнмәтінді дәл жеткізеді.
tips.ru: Слова symbolise, blessings, nomadic past точно передают культурный контекст.
tips.example: a special soup made of seven ingredients that symbolise happiness, luck and good health

tips.en: Rather than contrasts two ideas in one phrase.
tips.kk: Rather than екі көзқарасты бір тіркесте қарсы қояды.
tips.ru: Rather than противопоставляет два подхода одной фразой.
tips.example: a cause for celebration rather than just another date on the calendar

note.en: A vivid way to show continuity.
Warmth and a feeling of being part of a group.
Names the festival, states its significance and gives the date.
note.kk: Мерекені атап, оның мәнін түсіндіреді және күнін айтады.
note.ru: Называет праздник, объясняет его значение и называет дату.

note.en: Describes customs in order: preparation, food, street events, social visits.
note.kk: Дәстүрлерді ретімен сипаттайды: дайындық, тағам, көше іс-шаралары, қарым-қатынас.
note.ru: Описывает обычаи по порядку: подготовка, еда, уличные мероприятия, общение.

note.en: Explains cultural value and ends with a personal reflection.
note.kk: Мәдени құндылықты түсіндіріп, жеке естелікпен аяқтайды.
note.ru: Объясняет культурную ценность и завершается личным воспоминанием.
